title: Review packet verdict file
description: What a reviewer writes for one packet and one prompt variant: build/review/packet-NN.verdict-A.json (variant rubric-v1-a) or packet-NN.verdict-B.json (rubric-v1-b); a re-run after a failed control check is packet-NN.verdict-A.retry.json. One verdict per item of the packet, in any order. `python -m corpus_build review-ingest` checks it, maps item ids to content hashes, scores the packet's blind controls and writes review/verdicts.jsonl (one ReviewVerdict per real item, schemas/review-verdict.schema.json at the repo root) and review/batches.jsonl. See REVIEW.md.

promptVersion.description: Copied from the packet, for example rubric-v1.

promptVariant.description: rubric-v1-a for a verdict-A file, rubric-v1-b for a verdict-B file.

model.description: Model that answered, for the report.

completePhrase.description: Starts at a phrase beginning and contains whole phrases only.

conclusiveEnd.description: Ends with a cadence that sounds finished (or a clear half close at L3).

accompanimentLike.description: Reads as accompaniment, bass line or filler rather than a melody.

idiomaticForWinds.description: Playable as a single line on a wind instrument (breaths, range, figuration).

levelPlausible.description: The tagged level fits what the notes ask of the player.

reasons.description: Short reasons; required (at least one) for a reject.
